learning.description: The learned bundle behind a lean-ai export: identity, learner status and cost, kept and dropped counts.

locator.description: The prompt-time locator: the replay gate numbers, the frozen constants and the index rows (TSV lines, checked by the adapter).

rewrites.description: Verified command rewrites for the PreToolUse Bash hook.

learned.description: The learned bundle (olivium.learned/v1), checked by the reader and exported byte for byte as .olivium/learned.json.

native.description: Claude Code skills and subagents generated from repository history: provenance, what was left out and why, the test runner's allowed commands, and the measured cost.

rule.description: Per-origin requirements are enforced semantically. approved_claim: revision_hash, evidence and goal_id, with evidence or a goal, and no fingerprint/source. derived and overlay: fingerprint and source, and no revision_hash/evidence/goal_id.

practices.description: Counts from the bounded practices read (item 7): deprecation warnings emitted by the project's own source, the files they are in, 'will be removed' phrases, deprecation-policy sentences in maintainer documents, and whether the pytest configuration turns warnings into errors. No repository text.
